HOW IT WORKS

A tiny telephone exchange,
inside your browser.

The FSK transmitter makes the waveform in JavaScript. A separate receiver finds start bits and measures the two tone frequencies to recover the bytes. It receives only audio samples.

Advanced modes run the repository’s C modem engine in WebAssembly: one isolated instance per endpoint, exchanging 160-sample G.711 frames. Speaker playback is a separate copy of the signal.

This is a closed-loop software demonstration. It does not establish interoperability with physical modems. FSK starts with an idle carrier rather than a full V.25 call setup.
